ops.title: Restart com.yasyf.orca-serve now to apply the Orca db prune and the update to 1.4.259 (Nov 16, about 00:22)?
ops.body:
Yes. Owner's words, verbatim, in the orca-cleanup session at 2026-11-16 00:15: "do another orca sweep and db cleanup and remove dead sprites its polling etc also upate it from the altest verison using our standard process". The standard process (fix-slowdown skill) is launchctl bootout of com.yasyf.orca-serve, caffeinate -w on the old serve pid, then prune apply, the bundle swap and launchctl bootstrap.
Notes: authorizes the orca-serve unload and restart for this sweep only; never the terminal daemons, the Orca app process or any session.
